title: Add Part on work orders, estimates, part sales and POs treats not tracked as normal text
custom_preconds:
• Untracked parts exist at the location; none has "not tracked" in its own number or description.
  • An open work order, an estimate, a part sale and a new PO.
custom_steps:
1. On the work order, Add Part, type "not tracked" in Part Number.
  2. Repeat on the estimate, the part sale (Add Part) and the new PO (Part Number).
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • Only normal matches show (here: "No results"); untracked parts are not pulled in by the words not tracked.

Step 2:

  • Same on every screen.
